title: Montenegro 1943 - Mountain Stream - 5c Italian Occupation Issue Postage Stamp
descriptionText: The product is a 1943 Montenegro 5c Italian Occupation Issue postage stamp featuring a mountain stream. This mail aerea stamp was issued in Montenegro during the Italian occupation period and is described as being in new condition without any linguellato (cancelled) markings. With its unique design and historical significance, this postage stamp would make a valuable addition to any stamp collection or a great piece for those interested in European philately.
